result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
The best HR software for a small company depends on whether you primarily need employee management, payroll, scheduling, or a complete HR system.

**My top recommendation is BambooHR for overall HR management, and Rippling if you want HR, payroll, and technology management integrated.** However, since you're in Canada, I'd put extra emphasis on Canadian payroll, employment standards, and benefits support rather than choosing a platform based on US reviews.

## Best HR software for small businesses

| Software | Best for | Main advantages |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **Employment Hero (formerly Humi)** | Best overall Canadian option | HR, payroll, benefits, onboarding and hiring |
| **Collage HR** | Best all-in-one HR system | Employee records, time off, performance, payroll and benefits |
| **Rise People** | Best integrated HR platform | HR, payroll, benefits and employee self-service |
| **BambooHR** | Best dedicated HR software | Onboarding, employee records, performance reviews and reporting |
| **Wagepoint** | Best for simple payroll | Canadian payroll, tax remittances, T4s and ROEs |
| **Rippling** | Best for automation and growth | HR, payroll, IT, software access and workflow automation |


These are my leading candidates based on their capabilities and Canadian-market fit. ## My top three

![Humi | Avalon Accounting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aV3Tyz3-tu3Ua2Xm7WVQBpO1H00xNsE-uXVcxB6M3lZP2UWvHC2vLiEka8eGc6XXEcdljGfg21UMFEqFlr78cWjUpXEuhL40GY9156cDo8EGOuPvuaoz_8cStG_lJOHgN8zNS0RU3dLB24rMLdae3OnVeR8Ge471ucjOzOJdl93ilCYmtpNgcfVfOTm8qiEd?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Employment Hero (Humi)**

Best if you want one platform for most HR functions, including Canadian payroll and benefits. Particularly worth considering if you want to reduce administrative work.

Payroll advertised from \$7/employee/month, with a \$70 monthly minimum; HR pricing by quote.

[Employment Hero Canada](https://employmenthero.com/ca/)

---

![Best HR & Payroll Software in Canada | HRMS Platform | Collage HR | Michelle Crosby](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wuyRG9tdbgoL483PMQdEZmcGnvVDp28Ctt4FDtOUb1jzhvdiXu5swbTtmt2jnisbSBIImxmP4gLTyJBFV2XZW4ViccrXLAEMtfZrlfZDLcVB-vKB28NJNwMUmMraCnnNNEMW5IpEOkFa_veVcPY-ZgMB9UAENQ0tYVkmtwyFY9gS8znDZ1aBBBC1hIivlFSc?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Collage HR**

My pick if you want a dedicated HR platform with employee files, onboarding, vacation tracking, performance management and Canadian payroll.

Published starting pricing around \$14 CAD/employee/month for HR Premium; payroll-inclusive pricing is higher.

[Collage HR website](https://www.collage.co/)

---

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. BambooHR**

Best if your biggest concern is organizing HR rather than running payroll. Excellent candidate for employee information, onboarding, documentation and performance reviews.

Payroll for Canadian employees requires a separate solution or integration.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

[rankite.com](https://rankite.com/blog/best-hr-software-for-small-business-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ledgerlogic.ca](https://www.ledgerlogic.ca/blog/best-hr-software-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[technologyadvice.com](https://technologyadvice.com/blog/human-resources/best-hr-software-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I would choose

For a typical Canadian company with 5–50 employees, I'd shortlist **Employment Hero and Collage HR first**\.

Before deciding, compare\:

- Canadian payroll and CRA remittances
- Employee onboarding and digital signatures
- Vacation and sick-day tracking
- Performance reviews and employee records
- Benefits administration
- Employee self-service
- Employment standards and policy templates
- Total monthly cost, including implementation and add-ons

## Let me narrow it down to the best option

One question: **How many employees does your company have?**

That will help me recommend the best system based on your company size, budget and HR requirements rather than paying for features you don't need.

search_results.description: TechRadar’s 2026 guide evaluates leading HR software for payroll, compliance, recruitment, onboarding, benefits, performance management, and employee administration. Gusto is named best overall for its full-service payroll, time tracking, benefits administration, compliance support, and HR guidance. Employment Hero is recommended for small and medium-sized businesses because of its customizable workflows, automation, AI assistant, and broad feature set, though advanced functions and add-ons can increase costs. Rippling is best for versatility, particularly for distributed teams, offering remote device management, tax registration, scalable services, and per-employee billing. Other recommendations include Remote Payroll for international enterprises, BambooHR as an all-in-one system, Zoho People for integrations, Breathe HR for simple employee management, Deel for powerful global HR capabilities, PeopleHR for mobile access, Paylocity for mid-sized businesses, Staffology Payroll for complex enterprise payroll, Workable for recruitment, and BrightHR for extensive workforce-management features. The guide advises selecting software according to company size and specific workflow needs, and explains that testing considered usability, features, security, support, pricing, and user feedback.
